versions.subject: chore: split rules
versions.detection:
selection:
    Image|endswith: '/dseditgroup'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - ' -o edit ' #edit operation
        - ' -a ' # username
        - ' -t user'
        - 'admin' # Group name
condition: selection
versions.spl: Image="*/dseditgroup" CommandLine="* -o edit *" CommandLine="* -a *" CommandLine="* -t user*" CommandLine="*admin*"
